relation: definitional equality: X157's and X164's local output decoders x157_data_nth_nat / x164_data_nth_nat d i (identical bodies, unchanged since their authoring 8800958) are GTBase.complexity.data_nth_nat d i, the same fixpoint, so every certificate is a kernel conversion; the colour adapters x157_output_colour (modulo k, k = 0 included) and x164_output_colour (modulo 3), both at the vertex's enum rank, stay distinct and unchanged
summary: natural-data-decoder, one family over the existing module `GTBase.complexity` (re-exported by GTBase.base): the positional natural reader `data_nth_nat d i` of an output datum, added next to the scalar reader `data_nat_value` with the legacy body unchanged.

Its exact contract, corners included: position 0 of a Dcons cell is its head's natural value (0 for a non-Dnat head), position j+1 is position j of the tail; a scalar Dnat n, as a whole datum or as a malformed list tail, reads n at its position 0 and 0 after; Dnil and Dpair read 0 everywhere (`data_nth_nat0`, `data_nth_natS`, `data_nth_nat_Dnil`); on an encoded list of naturals it is nth 0 (`data_nth_nat_enc_list`, `data_nth_nat_enc_list_default`).

Chromatic X157 (local connectivity, fixed k >= 4, cost-coupled polytime output) and X164 (fixed surface and boundary, linear-time 3-colouring output) keep their decoders `x157_data_nth_nat` / `x164_data_nth_nat` as transparent aliases of `data_nth_nat d i`; nothing else in either file changes. The adapters `x157_output_colour` (modulo k, so modulo 0 keeps the value) and `x164_output_colour` (modulo 3) and every row guard, quantifier order and doc block stay as they were.

The certificates in `Chromatic.migration.natural_data_decoder` freeze both decoders and every same-file declaration through which a row reaches them (X157: output colour, output-or-none, polytime chain; X164: output colour, valid output, linear-time chain) and the two complete rows, all kernel conversions. `X157Original` composes the end-to-end pre-migration X157 row over the internal-vertices family's frozen chain (B2, baseline 9e03072) and this family's frozen decoding; X164 has no earlier snapshot.

X164 stays a documented blocked, unfaithful row (no extension precondition; orientable surface only; the boundary parameter does not constrain the embedding): its body, status and defect text are unchanged, and this migration neither repairs nor certifies its algorithmic claim.
